messages:
Sam G: CI alert — presubmit linux-x86 is red: checksum_test failing on multiple runners. Anyone able to bisect?
Maya R: @Sam any logs or failing assertion?
Sam G: Paste from one runner:
```
FAIL checksum_test.py::test_file_integrity
AssertionError: expected 0x1a3b but got 0x1a2b
---
stack: tests/checksum_test.py:42
```
Joel T: On it, I'll start a bisect against main and last-green. ETA ~15m. :eyes:
CI Bot: build/2117654321 presubmit started on linux-x86-runner-3
Nora L: heads up — I bumped tar-verify (2.3.7 -> 2.4.1) in #4389 yesterday, could be related to checksum logic change.
Maya R: good call. If bisect points there we can revert the bump quickly.
Joel T: running: `./scripts/ci_bisect --test checksum_test.py --workers 4 --last-green $(cat LAST_GREEN)`
Joel T: update: bisect narrowed to range, reproduces locally on ubuntu-20.04 in a docker dev image.
Joel T: first bad commit looks like `abcdef12` by Nora L — tar-verify bump.
Nora L: ack — I suspected the lib changed behavior. I'll open a revert and a patched bump with backward-compatible logic.
Sam G: can someone trigger a presubmit run after the revert PR? pinging @ci-oncall
Maya R: triggered rerun: https://ci.example.com/build/2117654399 — kicked off the revert job. :rocket:
CI Bot: build/2117654399 presubmit completed: all linux-x86 runners ✅
Sam G: nice work everyone, closing the bisect thread. Thanks Joel and Nora. :tada: :thumbsup:
Maya R: adding a brief postmortem comment on the PR about checksum semantics to avoid future surprises.
Joel T: also adding a short integration test that compares old/new algorithm outputs to catch this earlier.
Sam G: perfect.
